aiResearchSummary.text: Volta Labs is focused on enhancing genetic engineering automation through innovative fluid manipulation technologies. They are developing methods for biological assays using electrowetting on dielectric (EWOD) to process samples with precision. Their research includes magnetic bead-assisted separation, leveraging magnetic fields for artifact responsiveness. Surface coatings are also being explored to improve fluid movement reliability and accuracy. Additionally, they are investigating the use of electrode pads to control liquid droplet motion, aiming for smoother and more efficient operations. Volta Labs' R&D efforts are concentrated on refining droplet manipulation for more scalable genetic engineering solutions.
